# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multi-tier-app
description: A Helm chart for a multi-tier application with frontend, backend, and Postgres
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Global settings
global:
  environment: production

# Frontend configuration
frontend:
  name: frontend
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: nginx
    tag: stable
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  resources:
    requests:
      memory: "128Mi"
      cpu: "100m"
    limits:
      memory: "256Mi"
      cpu: "200m"
  config:
    appName: "Multi-Tier App"
    apiEndpoint: "/api"
  env:
    - name: BACKEND_URL
      value: "http://backend:8080"

# Backend configuration
backend:
  name: backend
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: node
    tag: 18-alpine
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 3000
  resources:
    requests:
      memory: "256Mi"
      cpu: "200m"
    limits:
      memory: "512Mi"
      cpu: "400m"
  config:
    logLevel: "info"
    maxConnections: 100
  env:
    - name: DB_HOST
      value: "postgres"
    - name: DB_PORT
      value: "5432"
    - name: DB_NAME
      value: "appdb"

# Database configuration
postgres:
  name: postgres
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: 15-alpine
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 5432
    targetPort: 5432
  resources:
    requests:
      memory: "512Mi"
      cpu: "250m"
    limits:
      memory: "1Gi"
      cpu: "500m"
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    size: 10Gi
    storageClass: ""
  config:
    maxConnections: 100
    sharedBuffers: "128MB"
  env:
    - name: POSTGRES_DB
      value: "appdb"

# Secrets configuration
secrets:
  postgres:
    username: "postgres"
    password: "changeme"
    rootPassword: "rootchangeme"
  backend:
    apiKey: "backend-api-key-12345"
    jwtSecret: "jwt-secret-key-67890"
  frontend:
    sessionSecret: "session-secret-key-abcde"

# Ingress configuration (optional)
ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations: {}
  hosts:
    - host: chart-example.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific
  tls: []
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "multi-tier-app.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "multi-tier-app.name" . }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}
{{ include "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.postgres.fullname" -}}
{{ include "multi-tier-app.fullname" . }}-{{ .Values.postgres.name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.backend.fullname" -}}
{{ include "multi-tier-app.fullname" . }}-{{ .Values.backend.name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "multi-tier-app.frontend.fullname" -}}
{{ include "multi-tier-app.fullname" . }}-{{ .Values.frontend.name }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/secrets.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.postgres.fullname" . }}-credentials
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
type: Opaque
data:
  postgres-username: {{ .Values.secrets.postgres.username | b64enc | quote }}
  postgres-password: {{ .Values.secrets.postgres.password | b64enc | quote }}
  postgres-root-password: {{ .Values.secrets.postgres.rootPassword | b64enc | quote }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.backend.fullname" . }}-credentials
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
type: Opaque
data:
  api-key: {{ .Values.secrets.backend.apiKey | b64enc | quote }}
  jwt-secret: {{ .Values.secrets.backend.jwtSecret | b64enc | quote }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.frontend.fullname" . }}-credentials
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
type: Opaque
data:
  session-secret: {{ .Values.secrets.frontend.sessionSecret | b64enc | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.frontend.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
data:
  app-name: {{ .Values.frontend.config.appName | quote }}
  api-endpoint: {{ .Values.frontend.config.apiEndpoint | quote }}
  nginx.conf: |
    server {
        listen {{ .Values.frontend.service.targetPort }};
        server_name localhost;
        location / {
            root /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index index.html index.htm;
        }
        location {{ .Values.frontend.config.apiEndpoint }} {
            proxy_pass http://{{ include "multi-tier-app.backend.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.backend.service.port }};
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        }
    }
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-backend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.backend.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
data:
  log-level: {{ .Values.backend.config.logLevel | quote }}
  max-connections: {{ .Values.backend.config.maxConnections | quote }}
  db-name: {{ .Values.backend.env[2].value | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-tier-app.postgres.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multi-tier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
data:
  postgresql.conf: |
    max_connections = {{ .Values.postgres.config.maxConnections }}
    shared_buffers = {{ .Values.postgres.config.sharedBuffers }}
  init.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        email VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        description TEXT,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );
